user.title: Set up PROXON HESP
user.description:
Independent community project for PROXON systems. Not an official integration of Zimmermann Lüftungs- und Wärmesysteme GmbH & Co. KG.

Receive-only test (up to 20 seconds). Supports the observed LT-ZIM V1.6 profile only. Programs other than Eco Summer have not been locally verified. Stop other TCP clients before testing.

data_description.profile: LT-ZIM V1.6: passive telemetry; optional manual device time alignment.

error.no_supported_data: TCP reachable, but no supported checksum-verified HESP data received.
error.invalid_input: Host and name must not be empty.

room_actuator_on.name: At least one heater switch on

init.title: Capture options
init.description: Applies to the next recording. Running and saved recordings are preserved. Memory limits may end a recording earlier.

data_description.event_capture_enabled: Buffers up to 180 seconds before and after a compressor start/stop or a change of experimental status bit 28 (0x0208). Automatically keeps the four latest recordings, replacing older ones. Memory only; restart discards them.

error.invalid_duration: Enter a whole number between 30 and 600.

user.title: Room and heaters (1/3)
user.description: Select this room’s existing switches and optional power measurements. Monitoring is read-only; existing thermostats remain responsible for control.

data_description.actuators: One or more switch entities. These are observed, never controlled.

references.title: Optional references (2/3)
references.description: All fields are optional. These references document the existing setup; they do not create duplicate sensors or a new thermostat. Leave empty and continue if not needed.

advanced.title: Measurement settings (3/3)
advanced.description: Defaults are a starting point. Choose a threshold above standby consumption and an age limit longer than the reporting interval. Without power measurements, heating remains unknown. Finish to save the room.

data_description.threshold: Heating is detected when the sum of valid measurements exceeds this threshold. Adjust above standby consumption.
data_description.max_age: 30–86400 seconds. Based on the last report to HA; choose a value longer than the source reporting interval.

error.invalid_room: Enter a name, at least one external switch and valid settings.
error.missing_source: A selected entity no longer exists. Select an existing entity.
error.source_in_use: A switch or power sensor is already assigned to another room.

abort.invalid_room: Enter a name, at least one external switch and valid settings.
abort.missing_source: A selected entity no longer exists. Select an existing entity.
abort.source_in_use: A switch or power sensor is already assigned to another room.

mark_observation.name: Mark diagnostic observation
mark_observation.description: Record a user-observed state in the running manual capture. Sends no device commands. The observation is not automatically verified and is included in the diagnostic export.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Select the PROXON entry with the running manual capture.

label.name: Observed indicator
label.description: Use the same label for all states, e.g. BDE fan selection. Up to 64 characters.

observation.name: Observed state
observation.description: Read the state now, e.g. auto or manual_3. Use the same text for identical states. Up to 160 characters; do not enter personal data.

entry_not_found.message: The PROXON integration entry was not found.

entry_not_loaded.message: The PROXON integration entry is not loaded.

capture_not_recording.message: Start a manual capture first. Completed captures cannot be annotated afterwards.

observation_limit.message: This capture already contains 128 observations. Stop it and download diagnostics.

invalid_observation.message: Indicator and state must be nonempty text: at most 64 and 160 characters respectively, without line breaks or control characters.
